Method of Attack: Local privilege elevation vulnerability exploiting a race condition in Windows Error Reporting to create a hardlink with elevated permissions
Allows modification or deletion of normally protected files like C:\Windows\System32\drivers\pci.sys
Discoverer: Gal De Leon of Palo Alto Networks
Attack Vector: Race condition exploit in Windows Error Reporting
Indicators of Compromise: Proof-of-concept exploit code on SandboxEscaper's GitHub repository
